observations: Large multifunctional printer with a touchscreen control panel.
The brand 'KONICA MINOLTA' and model 'bizhub PRO C754e' are clearly printed on the front panel in photo 0.
The machine has a black lower section and a white upper section with multiple paper trays.
The top glass surface is covered with plastic wrap.
The unit is located in an outdoor or semi-outdoor environment with other office equipment visible in the background.

claims.evidence: The touchscreen in photo 0 is too blurry to read the display content.

risks.risk: The touchscreen may be non-functional or have a dead pixel.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the touchscreen displaying a menu or a video of it navigating menus.

risks.risk: The internal print engine may be faulty or the toner cartridges may be empty.
risks.proof: A photo of the printer actively printing a test page.

risks.risk: The automatic document feeder (ADF) may be jammed or unable to scan.
risks.proof: A video showing the ADF feeding a document through and scanning it.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing essential components like the power cable or the original power supply unit.
risks.proof: A photo of the rear of the unit showing the power cable and the power supply.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the touchscreen displaying a menu or a test page.
Photo of the printer actively printing a test page.
Photo of the rear showing the power cable and power supply.
Video of the ADF feeding a document.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the front panel in photo 0. The item can be priced at its worst case (non-working) until functionality is proven.
